name: development-plugin-for-avalonia
description: Build, review, design, port, and migrate Avalonia applications through focused skills for app architecture, styling, rendering, platform services, design systems, and framework migration.

interface.shortDescription: Focused skills for building and porting Avalonia 12 apps
interface.longDescription: Use Development Plugin for Avalonia to build or review Avalonia 12 applications, route work into focused startup, styling, rendering, platform, and testing workflows, and handle HTML/CSS, WinForms, WPF, WinUI, and legacy Avalonia migration without drifting away from the local Avalonia 12 source baseline.
defaultPrompt: Build a modern Avalonia 12 app and route the work to the right specialist skill
Port this WPF, WinForms, WinUI, or HTML UI to Avalonia 12
Review an Avalonia 12 project for AOT-safe bindings, styling, and performance
